raw_text: Nagaland situation is deteriorating rapidly. NSCN-IM ceasefire appears to be breaking down and tribal organizations have called a total shutdown. Coordination happening through encrypted Telegram channels — blockade locations were being shared 6 hours before any mainstream outlet reported it. Assam Rifles on high alert near all major towns.
